from .precision import COMPUTE_DTYPES, REFINEMENT_DTYPES
from .safety import writable_path


def parser():
    root = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    commands = root.add_subparsers(dest="command", required=True)
    prepare = commands.add_parser(
        "prepare", help="Bin licensed Commons images to linear 16-bit caches"
    )
    prepare.add_argument("--source", type=Path, default=Path("/mnt/external/qi"))
    prepare.add_argument("--output", type=Path, required=True)
    prepare.add_argument("--limit", type=int, default=0)
    prepare.add_argument("--factor", type=int, default=8)
    prepare.add_argument("--min-size", type=int, default=256)
    prepare.add_argument("--workers", type=int, default=2)
    prepare.add_argument(
        "--selection-manifest",
        type=Path,
        help="Reprepare a frozen source selection at a new bin factor, preserving its splits",
    )
    training = commands.add_parser("train")
    training.add_argument("config", type=Path)
    training.add_argument("--resume", type=Path)
    training.add_argument(
        "--initialize", type=Path, help="Warm-start model weights with a fresh optimizer"
    )
    training.add_argument(
        "--stop-after", type=int, help="Save and exit after this many additional steps"
    )
    evaluate = commands.add_parser(
        "evaluate", help="Fixed held-out camera-linear and rendered PSNR"
    )
    evaluate.add_argument("checkpoint", type=Path)
    evaluate.add_argument("--manifest", type=Path, required=True)
    evaluate.add_argument("--split", choices=("val", "test"), default="val")
    evaluate.add_argument("--patch-size", type=int, default=256)
    evaluate.add_argument("--batch-size", type=int, default=4)
    evaluate.add_argument("--max-batches", type=int, default=0)
    evaluate.add_argument("--output", type=Path, required=True)
    evaluate.add_argument("--device", default="cuda")
    evaluate.add_argument(
        "--rawnind", type=Path, help="Directory containing separately fetched reference"
    )
    infer = commands.add_parser("infer", help="Camera RAW or 16-bit Bayer NPY/TIFF to RGB16 TIFF")
    infer.add_argument("checkpoint", type=Path)
    infer.add_argument("input", type=Path)
    infer.add_argument("output", type=Path)
    infer.add_argument("--preview", type=Path, help="Optional color-managed sRGB16 TIFF")
    infer.add_argument("--pattern", choices=("RGGB", "BGGR", "GRBG", "GBRG"), default="RGGB")
    infer.add_argument("--black", type=float, default=0)
    infer.add_argument("--white", type=float, default=65535)
    infer.add_argument("--shot", type=float, help="Var(y|x) = shot*x + read")
    infer.add_argument("--read", type=float, help="Normalized read-noise variance")
    infer.add_argument(
        "--noise-profile", type=Path, help="Reliable estimate from noise-profile command"
    )
    infer.add_argument("--tile", type=int, default=256)
    infer.add_argument("--overlap", type=int, default=64)
    infer.add_argument("--batch-size", type=int, default=4)
    infer.add_argument("--device", default="cuda")
    infer.add_argument(
        "--phase-harmonic",
        action="store_true",
        help="Experimental RAW-supported periodic-detail refinement after neural inference",
    )
    infer.add_argument(
        "--phase-harmonic-stride",
        type=int,
        default=128,
        help="Even native stride2..192 for optional fixed256-pixel harmonic patches",
    )
    infer.add_argument(
        "--phase-harmonic-envelope",
        choices=("detail", "cross", "wide", "sparse", "edge", "complex", "scalar"),
        default="detail",
        help="Detail restores amplitude inside cross-phase support; cross/wide/sparse/edge and earlier complex/scalar modes remain available",
    )
    infer.add_argument(
        "--phase-harmonic-device",
        help="TV solver device; defaults to the neural device (cpu selects the reference)",
    )
    infer.add_argument(
        "--phase-harmonic-refine-frequency",
        action="store_true",
        help="Refine active wave frequencies between FFT bins (automatic with sparse/wide/cross/detail)",
    )
    infer.add_argument(
        "--cudnn-benchmark",
        action="store_true",
        help="Autotune CUDA FP32 tiles (adds startup time;16GiB allocator cap)",
    )
    benchmark = commands.add_parser(
        "benchmark", help="Measure actual tiled large-image restoration"
    )
    benchmark.add_argument("checkpoint", type=Path)
    benchmark.add_argument("--height", type=int, default=10000)
    benchmark.add_argument("--width", type=int, default=10000)
    benchmark.add_argument("--tile", type=int, default=512)
    benchmark.add_argument("--overlap", type=int, default=64)
    benchmark.add_argument("--batch-size", type=int, default=8)
    benchmark.add_argument("--device", default="cuda")
    benchmark.add_argument("--output", type=Path, required=True)
    profile = commands.add_parser(
        "noise-profile", help="Estimate shot/read noise from flat RAW patches"
    )
    profile.add_argument("input", type=Path)
    profile.add_argument("output", type=Path)
    profile.add_argument("--patch", type=int, default=32)
    profile.add_argument("--max-patches", type=int, default=4096)
    quality = commands.add_parser("quality", help="Paired CFA/noise/exposure quality suite")
    quality.add_argument("checkpoint", type=Path, nargs="+")
    quality.add_argument("--manifest", type=Path, required=True)
    quality.add_argument("--output", type=Path, required=True)
    quality.add_argument("--config", type=Path, default=Path("configs/evaluation.yaml"))
    quality.add_argument("--split", choices=("val", "test"), default="val")
    quality.add_argument("--patch-size", type=int, default=256)
    quality.add_argument("--batch-size", type=int, default=4)
    quality.add_argument("--limit", type=int, default=0)
    quality.add_argument("--synthetic-count", type=int, default=8)
    quality.add_argument("--rawnind", type=Path)
    quality.add_argument("--gaussian-reference", type=Path)
    quality.add_argument("--nonlocal-reference", type=Path)
    quality.add_argument("--device", default="cuda")
    for command in (infer, benchmark, quality):
        command.add_argument(
            "--self-ensemble",
            choices=("none", "dihedral8"),
            default="none",
            help="Optional eight-view checkpoint quality mode; references keep one view",
        )
    for command in (infer, benchmark, quality):
        command.add_argument(
            "--precision",
            choices=COMPUTE_DTYPES,
            default="bfloat16",
            help="Neural compute precision; physical interpolation/color stays FP32",
        )
    for command in (evaluate, infer, benchmark, quality):
        command.add_argument(
            "--refinement-precision",
            choices=REFINEMENT_DTYPES,
            default="float32",
            help="RGB correction neural precision; sensor maps and scaling stay FP32",
        )
    audit = commands.add_parser(
        "audit-split", help="Screen protected splits for perceptual duplicates"
    )
    audit.add_argument("manifest", type=Path)
    audit.add_argument("output", type=Path)
    return root


def dump(path, data):
    path = writable_path(path)
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    path.write_text(json.dumps(data, indent=2) + "\n")
    print(json.dumps(data, indent=2), flush=True)


def main(argv=None):
    args = parser().parse_args(argv)
    torch.set_num_threads(4)
    torch.set_float32_matmul_precision("high")
    if args.command == "prepare":
        from .prepare import prepare_commons

        prepare_commons(
            args.source,
            args.output,
            limit=args.limit,
            factor=args.factor,
            min_size=args.min_size,
            workers=args.workers,
            selection_manifest=args.selection_manifest,
        )
    elif args.command == "train":
        from .train import train

        train(
            args.config, resume=args.resume, initialize=args.initialize, stop_after=args.stop_after
        )
    elif args.command == "evaluate":
        from torch.utils.data import DataLoader

        from .data import CleanDataset
        from .inference import load_checkpoint
        from .train import evaluate

        model, checkpoint = load_checkpoint(
            args.checkpoint, args.device, refinement_precision=args.refinement_precision
        )
        loader = DataLoader(
            CleanDataset(args.manifest, args.split, args.patch_size), batch_size=args.batch_size
        )
        scores = evaluate(model, loader, args.device, max_batches=args.max_batches)
        if args.rawnind:
            from .reference import load_rawnind

            for gain_mode in ("input-mean", "cfa-ls"):
                baseline = load_rawnind(args.rawnind, gain_mode=gain_mode, device=args.device)
                reference_scores = evaluate(
                    baseline, loader, args.device, max_batches=args.max_batches, amp=False
                )
                scores[f"rawnind_{gain_mode}"] = reference_scores
                del baseline
        dump(
            args.output,
            {
                "checkpoint": str(args.checkpoint),
                "step": checkpoint["step"],
                "manifest": str(args.manifest),
                "split": args.split,
                "patch_size": args.patch_size,
                "sources": len(loader.dataset),
                "batch_size": args.batch_size,
                "evaluated_images": min(len(loader.dataset), args.max_batches * args.batch_size)
                if args.max_batches > 0
                else len(loader.dataset),
                "max_batches": args.max_batches,
                "refinement_compute_precision": args.refinement_precision
                if args.device.startswith("cuda")
                else "float32",
                "noise": {"shot": 0.001, "read": 1e-6, "seed": 20261014},
                **scores,
            },
        )
    elif args.command == "infer":
        if args.phase_harmonic and (
            args.phase_harmonic_stride % 2 or not 2 <= args.phase_harmonic_stride <= 192
        ):
            raise ValueError("Phase-harmonic stride must be even and between2 and192")
        end_to_end_started = time.perf_counter()
        if args.cudnn_benchmark and (
            torch.device(args.device).type != "cuda"
            or args.precision != "float32"
            or args.refinement_precision != "float32"
        ):
            raise ValueError(
                "--cudnn-benchmark requires --device cuda and --precision float32 "
                "(including --refinement-precision float32)"
            )
        from .cfa import color_indices
        from .color import render
        from .inference import load_checkpoint, restore_tiled
        from .io import read_raw, write_rgb16
        from .precision import cudnn_autotune

        # Validate all destinations before performing expensive inference.
        output = writable_path(args.output)
        if output == args.input.resolve() or (
            args.preview and args.preview.resolve() == args.input.resolve()
        ):
            raise ValueError("Inference output must not overwrite its input")
        if args.preview:
            writable_path(args.preview)
            if args.preview.resolve() == output:
                raise ValueError("Linear and sRGB output paths must differ")
        if output == args.checkpoint.resolve() or (
            args.preview and args.preview.resolve() == args.checkpoint.resolve()
        ):
            raise ValueError("Inference output must not overwrite its checkpoint")
        profile = None
        if args.noise_profile:
            if args.shot is not None or args.read is not None:
                raise ValueError("Use a noise profile or explicit shot/read coefficients")
            profile = json.loads(args.noise_profile.read_text())
            estimate = profile.get("estimate", profile)
            if not estimate.get("reliable"):
                raise ValueError(f"Noise estimate is not identifiable: {estimate.get('reason')}")
            args.shot, args.read = estimate["shot"], estimate["read"]
        elif args.shot is None or args.read is None:
            raise ValueError("Supply both --shot and --read, or --noise-profile")
        suffix = args.input.suffix.lower()
        metadata = None
        if suffix in (".npy", ".tif", ".tiff"):
            if suffix == ".npy":
                raw = np.load(args.input, allow_pickle=False)
            else:
                import tifffile

                raw = tifffile.imread(args.input)
            if args.white <= args.black:
                raise ValueError("White level must exceed black level")
            if raw.ndim != 2:
                raise ValueError("Expected single-channel Bayer data")
            raw = (raw.astype(np.float32) - args.black) / (args.white - args.black)
            pattern, wb, matrix, flip = args.pattern, None, None, 0
        else:
            raw, metadata = read_raw(args.input)
            pattern, wb, matrix, flip = (
                metadata.pattern,
                metadata.white_balance,
                metadata.camera_to_srgb,
                metadata.flip,
            )
            if profile and profile.get("raw_metadata"):
                identity = profile["raw_metadata"]
                if identity["camera"] != metadata.camera or identity.get("iso") != metadata.iso:
                    raise ValueError("Noise profile camera/ISO differs from this RAW")
        with cudnn_autotune(
            args.device, enabled=args.cudnn_benchmark, precision=args.precision
        ) as backend_policy:
            model, checkpoint = load_checkpoint(
                args.checkpoint, args.device, refinement_precision=args.refinement_precision
            )
            if args.cudnn_benchmark and model.config.rgb_hidden_autocast:
                raise ValueError(
                    "Checkpoint forces hidden half precision; choose an FP32 checkpoint "
                    "for --cudnn-benchmark"
                )
            rgb, stats = restore_tiled(
                model,
                raw,
                color_indices(pattern),
                shot=args.shot,
                read=args.read,
                tile=args.tile,
                overlap=args.overlap,
                batch_size=args.batch_size,
                device=args.device,
                wb=wb,
                matrix=matrix,
                precision=args.precision,
                refinement_precision=args.refinement_precision,
                self_ensemble=args.self_ensemble,
            )
        stats["cudnn_autotune"] = backend_policy
        stats["phase_harmonic"] = {"enabled": False}
        if args.phase_harmonic:
            from .phase_harmonic import refine_phase_harmonics

            corrected, stats["phase_harmonic"] = refine_phase_harmonics(
                raw,
                color_indices(pattern),
                rgb.numpy(),
                shot=args.shot,
                read=args.read,
                stride=args.phase_harmonic_stride,
                envelope=args.phase_harmonic_envelope,
                tv_device=args.phase_harmonic_device or args.device,
                refine_frequency=args.phase_harmonic_refine_frequency,
            )
            rgb = torch.from_numpy(corrected)
        write_rgb16(output, rgb.permute(1, 2, 0).numpy(), metadata=metadata, flip=flip)
        if args.preview:
            preview = render(
                rgb[None],
                None if wb is None else torch.tensor(wb)[None],
                None if matrix is None else torch.tensor(matrix)[None],
            )[0]
            write_rgb16(
                args.preview,
                preview.permute(1, 2, 0).numpy(),
                metadata=metadata,
                color_space="sRGB",
                flip=flip,
            )
        dump(
            output.with_suffix(".json"),
            {
                "input": str(args.input),
                "checkpoint": str(args.checkpoint),
                "step": checkpoint.get("step"),
                "checkpoint_sha256": checkpoint["loaded_sha256"],
                "model_config": model.config.to_dict(),
                "shot": args.shot,
                "read": args.read,
                "pattern": pattern,
                "raw_metadata": asdict(metadata) if metadata else None,
                "noise_profile": str(args.noise_profile) if args.noise_profile else None,
                "end_to_end_seconds": time.perf_counter() - end_to_end_started,
                **stats,
            },
        )
    elif args.command == "audit-split":
        from .audit import audit_split

        audit_split(args.manifest, args.output)
    elif args.command == "quality":
        from .suite import run_suite

        run_suite(
            args.checkpoint,
            args.manifest,
            args.output,
            args.config,
            split=args.split,
            patch_size=args.patch_size,
            batch_size=args.batch_size,
            limit=args.limit,
            synthetic_count=args.synthetic_count,
            rawnind=args.rawnind,
            device=args.device,
            precision=args.precision,
            refinement_precision=args.refinement_precision,
            gaussian_reference=args.gaussian_reference,
            nonlocal_reference=args.nonlocal_reference,
            self_ensemble=args.self_ensemble,
        )
    elif args.command == "noise-profile":
        from .calibration import estimate_noise
        from .io import read_raw

        writable_path(args.output)
        if args.output.resolve() == args.input.resolve():
            raise ValueError("Noise profile must not overwrite its RAW input")
        raw, metadata = read_raw(args.input)
        estimate = estimate_noise(
            raw, patch=args.patch, max_patches=args.max_patches, metadata=metadata
        )
        dump(
            args.output,
            {
                "method": "flat-patch-Haar-NNLS-ADC-floor-v2",
                "raw_metadata": asdict(metadata),
                "estimate": estimate.to_dict(),
            },
        )
    elif args.command == "benchmark":
        from .cfa import color_indices
        from .inference import load_checkpoint, restore_tiled
        from .suite import freeze_checkpoint

        writable_path(args.output)
        if args.output.resolve() == args.checkpoint.resolve():
            raise ValueError("Benchmark output must not overwrite its checkpoint")
        frozen, digest = freeze_checkpoint(args.checkpoint, args.output.parent / "weights")
        model, checkpoint = load_checkpoint(
            frozen, args.device, refinement_precision=args.refinement_precision
        )
        # Warm kernels before timing; benchmark records hardware and dimensions.
        raw = torch.rand(args.height, args.width, generator=torch.Generator().manual_seed(42))
        kwargs = {
            "shot": 0.001,
            "read": 1e-6,
            "tile": args.tile,
            "overlap": args.overlap,
            "batch_size": args.batch_size,
            "device": args.device,
            "precision": args.precision,
            "self_ensemble": args.self_ensemble,
        }
        restore_tiled(model, raw[: args.tile, : args.tile], color_indices("RGGB"), **kwargs)
        rgb, stats = restore_tiled(model, raw, color_indices("RGGB"), **kwargs)
        dump(
            args.output,
            {
                "checkpoint": str(args.checkpoint),
                "checkpoint_snapshot": str(frozen),
                "checkpoint_sha256": digest,
                "model_config": model.config.to_dict(),
                "step": checkpoint.get("step"),
                "hardware": torch.cuda.get_device_name()
                if args.device.startswith("cuda")
                else "cpu",
                "torch": str(torch.__version__),
                "height": args.height,
                "width": args.width,
                "finite": bool(torch.isfinite(rgb).all()),
                "target_seconds": 10,
                "warmed": True,
                **stats,
            },
        )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Small native-pixel comparisons for performance reports (no image resampling)."""

import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw

from .color import render
from .safety import writable_path


def display_crop(rgb, wb, matrix, xywh, *, exposure=1.0):
    """Render just one B=1 camera-RGB crop, with an explicit common exposure."""
    x, y, w, h = xywh
    return (
        render(rgb[..., y : y + h, x : x + w] * exposure, wb, matrix)[0]
        .permute(1, 2, 0)
        .cpu()
        .numpy()
    )


def center_crop(shape, *, size=160, border=0):
    h, w = shape[-2:]
    size = min(size, h - 2 * border, w - 2 * border)
    if size < 1:
        raise ValueError("No pixels remain inside the report border")
    return [(w - size) // 2, (h - size) // 2, size, size]


def save_triplet(output, key, panels, *, caption, metadata):
    """Save three already-rendered HWC crops, each at exactly one pixel per pixel.

    No resizing, sharpening, independent exposure, or matplotlib rasterization.
    The receipt records each panel's exact pixel rectangle in the PNG canvas.
    """
    if len(panels) != 3:
        raise ValueError("A triplet requires noisy, denoised and reference panels")
    images = []
    for label, values in panels:
        values = np.asarray(values)
        if values.ndim != 3 or values.shape[-1] != 3 or not np.isfinite(values).all():
            raise ValueError("Expected finite HWC RGB display crops")
        images.append((label, np.rint(np.clip(values, 0, 1) * 255).astype(np.uint8)))
    shape = images[0][1].shape
    if any(values.shape != shape for _, values in images):
        raise ValueError("Native triplet panels must have matching dimensions")
    h, w, _ = shape
    gap, header = 8, 24
    canvas = Image.new("RGB", (3 * w + 4 * gap, h + header + gap), "#eeeeee")
    draw = ImageDraw.Draw(canvas)
    rectangles = []
    for i, (label, values) in enumerate(images):
        left = gap + i * (w + gap)
        draw.text((left, 5), label, fill="black")
        canvas.paste(Image.fromarray(values), (left, header))
        rectangles.append({"label": label, "png_xywh": [left, header, w, h]})
    output = writable_path(output)
    output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    name = f"crop-{hashlib.sha256(key.encode()).hexdigest()[:16]}"
    path = output / f"{name}.png"
    canvas.save(path)
    receipt = {
        "image": path.name,
        "caption": caption,
        "pixel_scale": "1 image pixel = 1 PNG pixel; open original at 100%",
        "display_encoding": "8-bit sRGB preview; evaluation uses unquantized predictions",
        "panels": rectangles,
        "png_sha256": hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
        **metadata,
    }
    path.with_suffix(".json").write_text(json.dumps(receipt, indent=2) + "\n")
    return receipt


def write_report(output, result, crops, *, title, note, metrics):
    """Place the selected native crops alongside the numerical report."""
    lines = [f"# {title}", "", note, "", "| Model / subset | " + " | ".join(metrics) + " |"]
    lines.append("| --- | " + " | ".join("---:" for _ in metrics) + " |")
    for row in result["overall"]:
        values = [row["metrics"].get(name, {}).get("mean") for name in metrics]
        formatted = [f"{value:.4f}" if value is not None else "—" for value in values]
        lines.append(f"| {row['model']} / {row['kind']} | " + " | ".join(formatted) + " |")
    lines += [
        "",
        "Crops are selected by source/condition before viewing model output. Each panel is",
        "a native 160-pixel crop (smaller only if the evaluation tile requires it), with",
        "identical color and exposure transforms. Open the PNG at 100% if the viewer scales it.",
        "Noisy = Malvar demosaicing without denoising. Crop receipts record coordinates and settings.",
        "",
    ]
    for crop in crops:
        lines += [crop["caption"], "", f"![Native crop comparison]({crop['image']})", ""]
        source = crop.get("source", {})
        if source.get("page_url"):
            lines += [
                (
                    f"Source: [{source.get('title', 'Wikimedia Commons')}]({source['page_url']}), "
                    f"{source.get('author', '')}, [{source.get('license', '')}]({source.get('license_url', '')}). "
                    f"Modified: {source.get('bin_factor', 8)}× binning, crop, synthetic sensor noise and restoration."
                ),
                "",
            ]
    lines += ["Full metrics, checkpoint hashes and protocol: [summary.json](summary.json).", ""]
    (Path(output) / "report.md").write_text("\n".join(lines))

    raw_kernel_phase_conditioning: bool = False
    raw_directional_residual: bool = False
    raw_directional_bank_context: bool = False
    raw_directional_bank_detach_input: bool = False
    raw_spectral_residual: bool = False
    raw_frequency_features: bool = False
    raw_frequency_window: int = 64
    raw_spatial_features: bool = False
    raw_global_features: bool = False
    raw_global_conditioning: str = "legacy-v1"
    late_rgb_refinement: str = "none"
    isotropic_groups: int = 6
    isotropic_blocks: int = 8
    isotropic_local_width: int = 32
    isotropic_raw_gain: float = 1.0
    isotropic_residual_scale: float = 1.0

    def to_dict(self):
        return asdict(self)

    @classmethod
    def from_checkpoint(cls, values):
        values = dict(values)
        values.setdefault("physical_fp32", values.pop("baseline_fp32", False))
        return cls(**values)


class PixelNorm(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, channels):
        super().__init__()
        self.norm = nn.LayerNorm(channels)

    def forward(self, x):
        return self.norm(x.permute(0, 2, 3, 1)).permute(0, 3, 1, 2)


class GatedBlock(nn.Module):
    """Local gated mixing; per-pixel normalization avoids tile statistics."""

    def __init__(self, channels):
        super().__init__()
        self.norm1, self.norm2 = PixelNorm(channels), PixelNorm(channels)
        self.expand = nn.Conv2d(channels, 2 * channels, 1)
        self.spatial = nn.Conv2d(2 * channels, 2 * channels, 3, padding=1, groups=2 * channels)
        self.project = nn.Conv2d(channels, channels, 1)
        self.ffn = nn.Conv2d(channels, 2 * channels, 1)
        self.ffn_out = nn.Conv2d(channels, channels, 1)
        self.scale1 = nn.Parameter(torch.full((1, channels, 1, 1), 0.1))
        self.scale2 = nn.Parameter(torch.full((1, channels, 1, 1), 0.1))

    def forward(self, x):
        a, b = self.spatial(self.expand(self.norm1(x))).chunk(2, 1)
        x = x + self.project(a * b) * self.scale1
        a, b = self.ffn(self.norm2(x)).chunk(2, 1)
        return x + self.ffn_out(a * b) * self.scale2


class NoiseModulation(nn.Module):
    """Identity-initialized spatial scale/shift from log sensor variance."""

    def __init__(self, channels):
        super().__init__()
        self.affine = nn.Sequential(nn.Conv2d(4, 32, 1), nn.SiLU(), nn.Conv2d(32, channels * 2, 1))
        nn.init.zeros_(self.affine[-1].weight)
        nn.init.zeros_(self.affine[-1].bias)

    def forward(self, x, log_variance):
        condition = F.interpolate(log_variance, size=x.shape[-2:], mode="area")
        scale, shift = self.affine(condition).chunk(2, 1)
        return x * (1 + 0.5 * scale.tanh()) + shift


class RgbNoiseRefiner(nn.Module):
    """Predict a noise-scaled RGB correction from the actual restored estimate.

    Unit-scale local residuals expose weak noise without requiring the network
    to reproduce the nonlinear Bayer prior. Decoder features retain structural
    context. Zero initialization preserves the base model; zero sensor variance
    makes the correction exactly zero. Physical operations keep IEEE FP32 math;
    neural operations default to FP32 with an optional FP16 inference mode.
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        context_channels,
        width=24,
        blocks=4,
        window=63,
        *,
        normalization_floor=1e-4,
        variance_floor=1e-8,
    ):
        super().__init__()
        if width < 12 or blocks < 0 or window < 3 or window % 2 == 0:
            raise ValueError("Invalid RGB noise-refinement configuration")
        self.window = window
        self.normalization_floor = normalization_floor
        self.variance_floor = variance_floor
        self.compute_precision = "float32"
        self.context = nn.Conv2d(context_channels, 12, 1)
        self.stem = nn.Conv2d(36, width, 3, padding=1)
        self.blocks = nn.Sequential(*(GatedBlock(width) for _ in range(blocks)))
        self.head = nn.Conv2d(width, 12, 3, padding=1)
        nn.init.zeros_(self.head.weight)
        nn.init.zeros_(self.head.bias)

    def forward(self, rgb, variance, colors, features):
        with torch.autocast(device_type=rgb.device.type, enabled=False), ieee_fp32():
            rgb_variance = bilinear(box_mean(variance.float().clamp_min(0), 7), colors)
            return self.from_rgb_variance(rgb, rgb_variance, features)

    def from_rgb_variance(self, rgb, rgb_variance, features):
        """Correct dense RGB using a specified RGB noise-scale proxy."""
        with torch.autocast(device_type=rgb.device.type, enabled=False), ieee_fp32():
            rgb = rgb.float()
            rgb_variance = rgb_variance.float()
            scale = rgb_variance.clamp_min(0).sqrt()
            residual = (rgb - box_mean(rgb, self.window)) / scale.clamp_min(
                self.normalization_floor
            )
            noise = (rgb_variance.clamp_min(self.variance_floor).log() + 12) / 6
            residual = F.pixel_unshuffle(residual.clamp(-8, 8), 2)
            noise = F.pixel_unshuffle(noise, 2)
            with amp_context(rgb.device, dtype=self.compute_precision):
                inputs = torch.cat((residual, noise, self.context(features.float())), dim=1)
                correction = F.pixel_shuffle(self.head(self.blocks(self.stem(inputs))), 2)
            return correction.float() * scale


class CoarseRgbNoiseRefiner(nn.Module):
    """Predict a smooth correction from pooled RGB and decoder context.

    Pooled input variance supplies a scale proxy, not an assertion that the
    nonlinear restoration residual is independent noise. The learned correction
    is zero at initialization and at zero sensor variance. Fine detail bypasses
    this branch; its output is interpolated back to the original RGB geometry.
    """

    def __init__(self, context_channels, factor=8, width=24, blocks=4, window=31):
        super().__init__()
        if factor not in (2, 4, 8, 16):
            raise ValueError("Coarse RGB factor must be 2, 4, 8 or 16")
        self.factor = factor
        self.network = RgbNoiseRefiner(
            context_channels, width, blocks, window, normalization_floor=1e-6, variance_floor=1e-12
        )

    def forward(self, rgb, variance, colors, features):
        with torch.autocast(device_type=rgb.device.type, enabled=False), ieee_fp32():
            h, w = features.shape[-2:]
            factor = self.factor
            ph, pw = -h % factor, -w % factor
            rgb_variance = bilinear(box_mean(variance.float().clamp_min(0), 7), colors)
            rgb = F.pad(rgb.float(), (0, 2 * pw, 0, 2 * ph), mode="replicate")
            rgb_variance = F.pad(rgb_variance, (0, 2 * pw, 0, 2 * ph), mode="replicate")
            features = F.pad(features.float(), (0, pw, 0, ph), mode="replicate")
            pooled = F.avg_pool2d(rgb, factor, factor)
            proxy = F.avg_pool2d(rgb_variance, factor, factor) / factor**2
            context = F.avg_pool2d(features, factor, factor)
            correction = self.network.from_rgb_variance(pooled, proxy, context)
            return F.interpolate(
                correction, scale_factor=factor, mode="bilinear", align_corners=False
            )[..., : 2 * h, : 2 * w]


class PyramidNoiseRefiner(nn.Module):
    """Multiscale noise-unit correction with explicit measured-CFA innovation.

    Innovation is the observation minus the current RGB estimate sampled at
    the actual CFA phases. Disabling it supplies zeros to the same channels,
    preserving initialization and capacity for a matched ablation. Physical
    feature construction/scaling stays IEEE FP32. No reference or target
    image is available to this module.
    """

    def __init__(self, context_channels, width=24, blocks=2, *, measurements=True):
        super().__init__()
        if width < 12 or blocks < 1:
            raise ValueError("Invalid pyramid refinement configuration")
        self.measurements = measurements
        self.compute_precision = "float32"
        self.context = nn.Conv2d(context_channels, 12, 1)
        self.stem = nn.Conv2d(52, width, 3, padding=1)
        self.encoders, self.downs = nn.ModuleList(), nn.ModuleList()
        channels = width
        for _ in range(2):
            self.encoders.append(nn.Sequential(*(GatedBlock(channels) for _ in range(blocks))))
            self.downs.append(nn.Conv2d(channels, channels * 2, 2, stride=2))
            channels *= 2
        self.middle = nn.Sequential(*(GatedBlock(channels) for _ in range(blocks)))
        self.ups, self.decoders = nn.ModuleList(), nn.ModuleList()
        for _ in range(2):
            self.ups.append(nn.Sequential(nn.Conv2d(channels, channels * 2, 1), nn.PixelShuffle(2)))
            channels //= 2
            self.decoders.append(nn.Sequential(*(GatedBlock(channels) for _ in range(blocks))))
        self.head = nn.Conv2d(width, 12, 3, padding=1)
        nn.init.zeros_(self.head.weight)
        nn.init.zeros_(self.head.bias)

    def forward(self, rgb, packed, variance, colors, features):
        with torch.autocast(device_type=rgb.device.type, enabled=False), ieee_fp32():
            rgb, packed = rgb.float(), packed.float()
            phase_variance = box_mean(variance.float().clamp_min(0), 7)
            rgb_variance = bilinear(phase_variance, colors)
            scale = rgb_variance.clamp_min(0).sqrt()
            residual = (rgb - box_mean(rgb, 63)) / scale.clamp_min(1e-4)
            noise = (rgb_variance.clamp_min(1e-8).log() + 12) / 6
            innovation = (
                (packed - mosaic(rgb, colors)) / phase_variance.clamp_min(1e-8).sqrt()
                if self.measurements
                else torch.zeros_like(packed)
            )
            if colors.ndim == 1:
                colors = colors[None].expand(rgb.shape[0], -1)
            h, w = packed.shape[-2:]
            labels = F.one_hot(colors, 3).float().flatten(1)[:, :, None, None].expand(-1, -1, h, w)
            with amp_context(rgb.device, dtype=self.compute_precision):
                inputs = torch.cat(
                    (
                        F.pixel_unshuffle(residual.clamp(-8, 8), 2),
                        F.pixel_unshuffle(noise, 2),
                        innovation.clamp(-8, 8),
                        labels,
                        self.context(features.float()),
                    ),
                    dim=1,
                )
                x = self.stem(F.pad(inputs, (0, -w % 4, 0, -h % 4), mode="replicate"))
                skips = []
                for encoder, down in zip(self.encoders, self.downs):
                    x = encoder(x)
                    skips.append(x)
                    x = down(x)
                x = self.middle(x)
                for up, decoder, skip in zip(self.ups, self.decoders, reversed(skips)):
                    x = decoder(up(x) + skip)
                correction = F.pixel_shuffle(self.head(x[..., :h, :w]), 2)
            return correction.float() * scale


class ChannelAttention(nn.Module):
    """Transposed attention: O(HW C²), used only on coarse spatial features."""

    def __init__(self, channels, heads=4):
        super().__init__()
        if channels % heads:
            raise ValueError("Attention width must be divisible by heads")
        self.heads = heads
        self.norm = PixelNorm(channels)
        self.qkv = nn.Conv2d(channels, 3 * channels, 1)
        self.local = nn.Conv2d(3 * channels, 3 * channels, 3, padding=1, groups=3 * channels)
        self.project = nn.Conv2d(channels, channels, 1)
        self.temperature = nn.Parameter(torch.ones(heads, 1, 1))
        self.scale = nn.Parameter(torch.full((1, channels, 1, 1), 0.1))

    def forward(self, x):
        batch, channels, h, w = x.shape
        q, k, v = (
            self.local(self.qkv(self.norm(x)))
            .reshape(batch, 3, self.heads, channels // self.heads, h * w)
            .unbind(1)
        )
        q, k = F.normalize(q.float(), dim=-1), F.normalize(k.float(), dim=-1)
        attention = ((q @ k.transpose(-2, -1)) * self.temperature).softmax(-1).to(v.dtype)
        mixed = (attention @ v).reshape(batch, channels, h, w)
        return x + self.project(mixed) * self.scale


class DinoContext(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, config, channels):
        super().__init__()
        from transformers import AutoModel

        # No random fallback: access failures are actionable errors.
        self.backbone = AutoModel.from_pretrained(config.dino_model, revision=config.dino_revision)
        if getattr(self.backbone.config, "model_type", None) == "dinov3_convnext":
            raise ValueError("DINOv3 ConvNeXt requires dino_feature_fusion: convnext-pyramid")
        # Frozen weights are loaded separately; pin the exact upstream revision.
        config.dino_revision = (
            getattr(self.backbone.config, "_commit_hash", None) or config.dino_revision
        )
        self.backbone.requires_grad_(False).eval()
        if config.dino_lora_rank:
            from .dino_adaptation import install_qv_adapters

            self.lora = install_qv_adapters(self.backbone, config.dino_lora_rank)
        else:
            self.lora = nn.ModuleDict()
        self.adapter = nn.Conv2d(self.backbone.config.hidden_size * 3, channels, 1)
        self.gate = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(1, channels, 1, 1))
        self.register_buffer("mean", torch.tensor([0.485, 0.456, 0.406])[None, :, None, None])
        self.register_buffer("std", torch.tensor([0.229, 0.224, 0.225])[None, :, None, None])
        self.input_adapter = None
        if config.dino_input_adapter:
            from .dino_adaptation import DinoInputAdapter

            # Keep subsequent common layers' initialization and global RNG
            # identical when adding an initially identity feature-input path.
            with torch.random.fork_rng(devices=[]):
                self.input_adapter = DinoInputAdapter()

    def train(self, mode=True):
        super().train(mode)
        self.backbone.eval()
        return self

    def forward(self, preview, size):
        if self.input_adapter is not None:
            preview = self.input_adapter(preview)
        # Keep native token geometry and pad to 16, without a classification crop.
        h, w = preview.shape[-2:]
        preview = F.pad(preview, (0, -w % 16, 0, -h % 16), mode="replicate")
        adapt_encoder_input = self.input_adapter is not None or bool(self.lora)
        with torch.set_grad_enabled(adapt_encoder_input and torch.is_grad_enabled()):
            outputs = self.backbone(
                pixel_values=(preview - self.mean) / self.std, output_hidden_states=True
            )
            hidden = outputs.hidden_states
            n = len(hidden) - 1
            selected = [hidden[max(1, n // 3)], hidden[max(1, 2 * n // 3)], hidden[-1]]
            ph, pw = preview.shape[-2] // 16, preview.shape[-1] // 16
            # CLS + register tokens precede patch tokens in DINOv3.
            features = torch.cat(
                [
                    s[:, -(ph * pw) :].transpose(1, 2).reshape(preview.shape[0], -1, ph, pw)
                    for s in selected
                ],
                dim=1,
            )
        return (
            F.interpolate(self.adapter(features), size=size, mode="bilinear", align_corners=False)
            * self.gate
        )


class JointDemosaic(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, config: ModelConfig | None = None):
        super().__init__()
        self.config = config or ModelConfig()
        self.refinement_precision = "float32"
        cfg = self.config
        units = (cfg.isotropic_raw_gain, cfg.isotropic_residual_scale)
        if any(
            type(value) not in (int, float) or not math.isfinite(value) or value <= 0
            for value in units
        ):
            raise ValueError("Isotropic RAW gain and residual scale must be finite and positive")
        if units != (1, 1) and cfg.restoration_backbone != "packed-isotropic":
            raise ValueError("Isotropic RAW/residual units require the packed-isotropic backbone")
        if type(cfg.raw_kernel_reconstruction) is not bool:
            raise ValueError("RAW kernel reconstruction must be a boolean")
        if cfg.raw_kernel_reconstruction and cfg.restoration_backbone != "pretrained-rgb":
            raise ValueError("RAW kernel reconstruction requires the pretrained RGB backbone")
        if type(cfg.raw_directional_residual) is not bool:
            raise ValueError("RAW directional residual must be a boolean")
        if type(cfg.raw_directional_bank_context) is not bool:
            raise ValueError("RAW directional bank context must be a boolean")
        if cfg.raw_directional_bank_context and not cfg.raw_directional_residual:
            raise ValueError("RAW directional bank context requires the directional branch")
        if type(cfg.raw_directional_bank_detach_input) is not bool:
            raise ValueError("RAW directional bank input detachment must be a boolean")
        if cfg.raw_directional_bank_detach_input and not cfg.raw_directional_bank_context:
            raise ValueError("RAW directional bank input detachment requires bank context")
        if type(cfg.raw_spectral_residual) is not bool:
            raise ValueError("RAW spectral residual must be a boolean")
        if type(cfg.raw_frequency_features) is not bool:
            raise ValueError("RAW frequency features must be a boolean")
        from .raw_frequency_features import validate_frequency_window

        validate_frequency_window(cfg.raw_frequency_window)
        if not cfg.raw_frequency_features and cfg.raw_frequency_window != 64:
            raise ValueError("Nondefault RAW frequency window requires frequency features")
        if type(cfg.raw_spatial_features) is not bool:
            raise ValueError("RAW spatial features must be a boolean")
        if type(cfg.raw_global_features) is not bool:
            raise ValueError("RAW global features must be a boolean")
        if type(cfg.raw_global_conditioning) is not str or cfg.raw_global_conditioning not in (
            "legacy-v1",
            "cosine-rms-v2",
            "memory-only-v3",
            "patch-memory-v4",
        ):
            raise ValueError("Unknown RAW global conditioning mode")
        if cfg.raw_global_conditioning != "legacy-v1" and not cfg.raw_global_features:
            raise ValueError("RAW global conditioning requires global features")
        if cfg.raw_global_features and (
            cfg.restoration_backbone != "pretrained-rgb"
            or not cfg.variance_stabilization
            or not cfg.physical_anchors
            or cfg.rgb_processing_scale != 1
            or cfg.raw_kernel_reconstruction
            or cfg.raw_directional_residual
            or cfg.raw_spectral_residual
            or cfg.raw_frequency_features
            or cfg.raw_spatial_features
            or cfg.adc_cfa_projection
            or cfg.late_rgb_refinement != "none"
        ):
            raise ValueError(
                "RAW global features require native anchored RGB without other RAW heads"
            )
        if cfg.raw_spatial_features and (
            cfg.restoration_backbone != "pretrained-rgb"
            or not cfg.variance_stabilization
            or not cfg.physical_anchors
            or cfg.rgb_processing_scale != 1
            or cfg.raw_kernel_reconstruction
            or cfg.raw_directional_residual
            or cfg.raw_spectral_residual
            or cfg.raw_frequency_features
            or cfg.adc_cfa_projection
            or cfg.late_rgb_refinement != "none"
        ):
            raise ValueError(

        if cfg.raw_frequency_features and (

            or not cfg.variance_stabilization
            or not cfg.physical_anchors
            or cfg.rgb_processing_scale != 1
            or cfg.raw_kernel_reconstruction
            or cfg.raw_directional_residual
            or cfg.raw_spectral_residual
            or cfg.adc_cfa_projection

        ):

            or cfg.dino_feature_fusion != "convnext-pyramid"
            or not cfg.variance_stabilization
            or not cfg.physical_anchors
            or cfg.rgb_processing_scale != 1
            or cfg.raw_kernel_reconstruction
            or cfg.raw_directional_residual
            or cfg.raw_spectral_residual
            or cfg.adc_cfa_projection
        ):

        if cfg.raw_spectral_residual and (

        ):

        if cfg.dino_feature_fusion not in ("bottleneck", "convnext-pyramid", "packed-convnext"):

        ):

        if cfg.dino_feature_fusion == "convnext-pyramid" and (

        ):
            raise ValueError(

            )

        if type(cfg.raw_kernel_phase_conditioning) is not bool:

        if cfg.raw_kernel_phase_conditioning and not cfg.raw_kernel_reconstruction:

        if cfg.packed_detail_prior and cfg.rgb_processing_scale != 2:

        ):
            raise ValueError("Packed RGB processing requires the stabilized pretrained backbone")
        if cfg.physical_anchors and not cfg.variance_stabilization:
            raise ValueError("Physical anchors require variance stabilization")
        if cfg.restoration_backbone not in ("local", "pretrained-rgb", "packed-isotropic"):

        if cfg.rgb_hidden_autocast and cfg.restoration_backbone != "pretrained-rgb":
            raise ValueError("RGB hidden autocast requires the pretrained RGB backbone")
        if cfg.variance_stabilization and cfg.restoration_backbone != "pretrained-rgb":

            if (
                not cfg.physical_fp32

                or cfg.baseline != "bilinear"
                or cfg.noise_modulation
                or cfg.standardized_noise
                or cfg.noise_refinement

                    "no legacy refiners, and packed-convnext fusion when DINO is enabled"

            from .packed_isotropic import PackedIsotropic

            self.packed_isotropic = PackedIsotropic(
                cfg.width,
                cfg.isotropic_groups,
                cfg.isotropic_blocks,
                cfg.isotropic_local_width,
                raw_gain=cfg.isotropic_raw_gain,
                residual_scale=cfg.isotropic_residual_scale,
